title: Working calendars ④: approval escalation clock key (wall_clock | working_time)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb

③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer ruling on #35340 (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35340#issuecomment-7000950747; sub-cards approved 2026-11-19 06:03Z 「同意」「都是 p1」).

Blocked-by: #35354
Waits on #35354 (the ADR) and on the calendar service from ②. Ships in the same release as ② and ③.

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 审批超时按自然小时算，夜里、周末、节假日都算进去。
- **要做：** 给审批升级加一个时钟选项，可以按工作时间算；日历算不出时不升级，并在到期时间处写明原因。
- **不做会怎样：** 周五下午提交的审批周五晚上就升级，客户看到的到期时间不对。
- **你要做的：** 无。

## Scope
- `ApprovalEscalationSchema` (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` ~855-875): add `clock: 'wall_clock' | 'working_time'` (default `wall_clock`) and an optional `calendar` (code). Rewrite the `timeoutHours` describe text and the code comment that say the platform ships no calendar.
- The default stays `wall_clock`. The sweep reads stored node-config snapshots (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` ~8055), so existing requests keep their deadlines.
- Sweep, with `working_time`: compute the deadline from `created_at` through the calendar service (`addWorkingHours`), and recompute it on every sweep rather than storing it (ADR-0157 D12; ADR-0042 §1 single-shot escalation and §3 stand).
- Calendar resolution follows the ADR: explicit code, then the org default, then refuse. There is never a silent wall-clock fallback.
- **When the calendar can't answer** (it is missing, or not maintained that far; ADR-0157 D8/D9, ruling record 7003541720): the sweep does not escalate, retries on the next sweep, and the displayed due time shows 「日历算不出」 with the reason. The publish-time lint checks only static authoring errors, e.g. a `calendar` code without `clock: 'working_time'`. ⛔ **No publish-time check that the calendar exists.** That is per-org runtime data, and the lint is a pure `(stack) => Finding[]`. *(Corrected 2026-11-19 from "a `working_time` escalation with no resolvable calendar is a lint/validation error", per ADR-0157 D9.)*
- Studio designer field for the clock and calendar; docs and skills teaching text.
- Only `timeoutHours` gets a clock key. Other duration keys get one card each, later.

## Done when
A `working_time` escalation opened Friday 17:00 with 4 hours fires on the next working day per the calendar, including across a holiday and a 调休 make-up Saturday. A request whose calendar can't answer doesn't escalate and shows the reason where the due time is displayed. `wall_clock` behaviour is unchanged.

## Non-goals
Flipping the default clock; clock keys on other duration keys.
